data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that implicitly animates a list when it rebuilds with new items.
data.what_it_does: ImplicitlyAnimatedList automatically animates list items whenever the underlying data changes, such as insertions, deletions, or reorderings. It also provides a SliverImplicitlyAnimatedList variant for use inside a CustomScrollView.
use_when: You need list items to smoothly animate when items are added, removed, or reordered.
You are using StreamBuilder to supply a changing list of data.
avoid_when: You require explicit control over animation controllers for complex choreographed sequences.
strengths: Easy to integrate by just passing item data and an itemBuilder.
Supports both standard lists and slivers.
Allows customizing insert and delete durations.
weaknesses: Relies on the `==` operator of items for equality comparisons unless customized.
data.minimal_example:
ImplicitlyAnimatedList(
  itemData: [1, 2, 3, 4],
  itemBuilder: (_, number) => ListTile(title: Text('$number')),
)
